title: Inverse reinforcement learning for indefinite mean-field social optimization with multiplicative noise
summary: This paper studies the inverse reinforcement learning (RL) problem for linear-quadratic mean-field (MF) social optimization. The considered system features multiplicative noise and indefinite cost weights, which violate standard convexity assumptions and pose analytical challenges. The goal is to recover unknown social cost weights from expert demonstrations and reproduce the optimal control policies.
